slides.title: Which CV design suits *your* job?
slides.sub: A quick guide to four of our 51 designs.

slides.title: Heritage
slides.body: Calm and classic: one column, quiet rules, no photo. A good fit for managers, office and formal roles.

slides.title: Clarity
slides.body: Single column with a clean accent line. Easy for anyone to read. Works for drivers, trades, office and general jobs.

slides.title: Violet
slides.body: A portrait and a deep violet column. Popular for healthcare, teaching, tech and students.

slides.title: Atelier
slides.body: A coloured sidebar with your name, photo and contact. Confident and creative, for tech, students and retail.

slides.title: Try them on your own CV
slides.sub: Switch designs any time without losing a word. Every design has a plain version for online forms.
